en.text:
Finishing a reload after having dealt damage with the weapon grants a Stack of Splicer Surge. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

Splicer Surge grants the following at 1|2|3 Stacks:
• 10? | 20? | 45? Handling
• 10 | 20 | 45 Reload Speed
• 3.3% | 6.6% | 10% decreased Reload Animation Duration

Stowing the weapon removes the buff.
